title: Preview origin isolation by dedicated port (warren-3f8a)
rationale: Candidate (a) HttpOnly operator cookie fails: same-origin preview JS can still ride the cookie via fetch, and any CSRF-token recovery endpoint is equally fetchable by the preview. Candidate (c) sandbox-CSP + SameSite=None breaks preview apps' own fetch() calls (opaque origin => CORS, credentials omitted) and ACAO:null would let any site read previews. A second listener changes the browser ORIGIN while keeping the same SITE, so the host-scoped SameSite=Lax preview cookie flows across ports unchanged.

content: bootPreviewSurface (src/server/main/preview-wiring.ts) is the preview topology decision point: subdomain mode mounts the proxy as the main-listener preamble; path mode on TCP boots the dedicated preview listener (src/server/preview-server.ts) and mounts createPreviewPathRedirect (308) on the main listener; path mode on the unix transport keeps legacy same-origin mounting with a warren-3f8a boot warning. launchConfig.port carries the RESOLVED listener port to every URL builder (PR annotation, /preview/config, login handshake) — never re-derive it.

Adding a readPublic/anonymous route to ROUTE_TABLE requires a deliberate edit to the SPECTATOR_ROUTES literal in src/server/handlers/index.test.ts ('the spectator surface is exactly the enumerated routes'), plus regenerating docs/http-api.md and docs/openapi.yaml. Single-project GET bodies are the bare row (not { project }), matching the SDK's Promise<ProjectRow>.

All detail GETs wrap: GET /runs/:id → {run: ...}; GET /plan-runs/:id → {planRun, children, runs}. POST /runs → {run: ...}. Any consumer parsing GET /runs/:id as a bare run object reads all-null — update scripts and docs that predate PR #815.

Adding anonymous HTTP routes (e.g. /github-app/register + /callback, warren-a647): (1) add the path prefix to API_PREFIXES in src/server/handlers/index.ts; (2) add the routes to SPECTATOR_ROUTES in handlers/index.test.ts with a justification comment; (3) the handler must never answer 401/403 — policy.wire.test.ts asserts spectator routes never do, so a state-gated refusal uses 400. handlers/index.ts sits at the 500-line check:size ceiling, so keep route-table comments to one line and put rationale in the handler module. New docs prose must pass check-prose (ASD-STE100 subset): no semicolons, no passive voice, sentences <=25 words, paragraphs <=6 sentences.

name: global-stream-route-prefix
description: Adding a top-level stream route: its prefix must be added to API_PREFIXES in src/server/handlers/route-table.ts or the public-mode auth gate treats it as a non-API path (isAuthExempt/policy.wire tests fail). For ServerDeps singletons needed before buildServerDeps, have bootLifecycleBus build and return them on LifecycleBusHandle to keep main/index.ts under the 500-line budget (warren-f566).

pino LOG_REDACT_OPTIONS censors the field name 'token' (and *.token) — a log line intended for an operator to READ a credential must use a deliberately-named non-redacted field (see bootServer's mintedOperatorToken, warren-ef6e)
resolution: log the minted token under 'mintedOperatorToken' with a comment naming the intentional exception

description: extensions/judge first live deploy (warren-5fcf): JudgeResourceLoader.getExtensions() returned runtime:undefined, but pi SDK's ExtensionRunner.bindCore assigns methods onto that object unconditionally — every judgment failed instantly ('undefined is not an object evaluating this.runtime.sendMessage') and one collector cycle burned the whole 334-run backlog into judge_error markers. Compounding: the unjudged marker's detail string was never persisted or logged, so the pod was undiagnosable; and cursors never re-open on unjudged under the same (rubricVersion, judgeModelId) pair, so recovery required wiping judge.db on the PVC.
resolution: PR #968: hermetic loader returns fresh createExtensionRuntime() per session; index.ts logs (reason+detail) for every unjudged outcome via onJudgment. Deploy: image at us-west1-docker.pkg.dev/warren-502318/warren/warren-ext-judge, manifests deploy/k8s/extensions/judge/ + gitignored gke-live-judge overlay, judge-secrets in warren ns (export token at ~/.warren/judge-export-token, openrouter key mirrored from warren-runs), openrouter/google/gemini-3.7-flash at $20/day. Verify one real judgment locally BEFORE pointing a fresh judge at a backlog.

description: judge fleet budget gate (extensions/judge collector): recordBudgetSkip wrote a budget_exceeded marker AND checkpointed the cursor for every run past the daily budget — with needsJudgment never re-opening under the same (rubricVersion, judgeModelId) pair AND the verdict store's dedupe key (runId|rubricVersion|judgeModelId) shared across row kinds, the first budget-exhausted cycle would have permanently written off the remaining ~190 of 334 backlog runs and blocked their future verdicts. Caught pre-trip while sizing the warren-5fcf drain.
resolution: PR #969: fleet gate DEFERS (no marker, no checkpoint; once-per-cycle log + budgetDeferred stat); per-judgment cap breach mid-attempt still resolves with a marker (attempts were billed). Lesson: before relying on a budget/skip path, trace what its bookkeeping writes make PERMANENT — a skip that shares the resolution machinery of success is a write-off, not a skip.

name: ops-overview-endpoint-pattern
description: Ops-overview endpoint pattern (pl-7e38 step 12): new readPublic analytics-style endpoints put SQL aggregation in a domain module under src/runs/ and a thin handler under src/server/handlers/, consume deps.dbAdapter (never build repos in handlers), and must (a) add the route to the SPECTATOR_ROUTES enumeration in src/server/handlers/index.test.ts, (b) reduce via isPublicOnly+pickFields allowlist, (c) regenerate docs/openapi, (d) pin new public envelopes in a __golden__/responses fixture. Note: fresh workspaces need bun install at root AND extensions/judge (typebox) or bun test fails with unhandled module errors.

name: new-api-route-two-registrations
description: Adding an API route needs two registrations: a ROUTE_TABLE entry AND its top-level prefix in API_PREFIXES — isAuthExempt() skips the auth gate for any path not under an API prefix, so a readPublic route missing from API_PREFIXES serves unauthenticated with the full operator body. Also gen:docs parseEntry only recognizes 'build: handler' or 'build: () => handler' — an inline '(deps) => fn(deps)' build is silently dropped from docs/openapi.

name: setup-handoff-one-time-code
description: warren-48f8 one-time browser auth handoff: boot-armed SetupHandoffStore (src/server/setup-handoff.ts) mints a single-use 10-min code bound to the operator token; GET /setup redeems it into a CSP-nonce'd page writing the SPA's warren.apiToken localStorage key then redirecting to /. Anonymous route gated by store presence (404 unarmed, never 401/403 so scenario 39 holds); refuses to arm under WARREN_AUTH=public or --no-auth. Only warren up passes BootServerOptions.setupHandoff.

content: Adding an anonymous route to ROUTE_TABLE requires: API_PREFIXES entry, spectator-list edit in handlers/index.test.ts, FLOW_ROUTE_EXPECTED_STATUS/FLOW_PAGE_PATTERNS entries in scripts/acceptance/scenarios/39-public-exposure.leaks.ts when the route is a browser navigation target, and gen:docs+gen:openapi regeneration. Unarmed anonymous routes must answer 404 (jsonResponse + cache-control no-store when swept as a flow page); never 401/403 for a bare anonymous hit.

name: judge-export-proxy
description: Judge export proxy: server-held WARREN_JUDGE_BASE_URL/WARREN_JUDGE_EXPORT_TOKEN reverse-proxy at GET /extensions/judge/verdicts.jsonl keeps the extension token off the browser and inside CSP connect-src 'self'; unconfigured answers 501 judge_not_configured (warren-1b40)

name: forge-capability-route
description: Forge capability-flag routes (warren-2601): extend ForgeCapabilities + Forge method (listInstallationRepos), implement in github-app provider only, PAT/fake return 'unsupported'; handler answers 200 {supported:false, repos:[]} for every non-picker arm so the UI has one discriminant. route-table.ts sits exactly at its 500-line budget — trim comments elsewhere when adding routes.

title: Runs list overlays the dispatch-context cap
rationale: The mobile runs card needs cap % and a near-cap warning tint (warren-f8a2), but the runs table carries no cap column; the dispatch_context snapshot does.
